teams.description: Stores information about registered hackathon teams and their members. Team name acts as the unique identifier.

teamName.description: The unique name of the team.

problemStatement.description: The problem statement chosen by the team.

leadEmail.description: The email of the team lead.

leadData.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON string containing the team lead's PII.

membersData.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON string containing an array of 3 members' PII.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the team was registered.

roles.description: Stores authentication and role information for privileged users (Admins, Jury, Coordinators). Document ID is the user email (lowercase).

role.description: The role of the user: 'admin', 'jury', or 'coordinator'.

name.description: Full name of the user (set for jury and coordinator roles).

institution.description: Institution / organisation name (set for jury role only).

department.description: Department name (set for coordinator role only).

encryptedCreds.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted string storing the password/credentials.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

jury.description: Stores profile information for jury members. A document is created here whenever a jury login account is created via the admin panel.

juryName.description: The full name of the jury member.

institution.description: Institution / Organisation of the jury member.

email.description: Login email of the jury member. Used to link the jury profile to the Firebase Auth account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the jury profile was created.

coordinators.description: Stores profile information for coordinators. A document is created here whenever a coordinator login account is created via the admin panel.

email.description: Login email of the coordinator. Used to link the profile to the Firebase Auth account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the coordinator profile was created.

scores.description: Stores the detailed rubric-based score given to a team by its assigned jury.

teamId.description: The document ID (or unique identifier) of the team.

rubric.description: Detailed scoring breakdown across evaluation criteria.

finalOutput.description: Score for the final output / demo.

totalScore.description: The sum of all rubric scores (idea + output + innovation + presentation + finalOutput).

starred.description: Indicates whether the jury highlighted/starred the team.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score record was last modified.
